steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const lines = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.map((m) => m.mes); const state = rt.getEngineState(); const values = state.blackboard.values; if (lines.length !== 3 || !String(lines[1]).includes('oil lamp') || !String(lines[2]).includes('map')) throw new Error(`the chat is not the three scripted lines: ${JSON.stringify(lines)}`); if (state.lastMessageId !== 2) throw new Error(`the engine consumed up to message ${state.lastMessageId}, expected 2`); for (const key of ['took_key', 'lit_lamp', 'found_map']) if (values[key] !== true) throw new Error(`${key} did not land before the move: ${JSON.stringify(values)}`); return { values, boundary: state.boundary };

const $ = globalThis.jQuery; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const until = async (test, what) => { for (let i = 0; i < 40; i += 1) { if (test()) return; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error(`the message editor never ${what}`); }; $('.mes[mesid="1"] .mes_edit').first().trigger('click'); await until(() => document.querySelector('#curEditTextarea'), 'opened on message 1'); $('.mes[mesid="1"] .mes_edit_down').first().trigger('click'); await until(() => String(ctx.chat[1]?.mes).includes('map') && String(ctx.chat[2]?.mes).includes('oil lamp'), 'swapped messages 1 and 2 (H6)'); const seen = []; const handler = (id) => seen.push(id); ctx.eventSource.on(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_UPDATED, handler); try { $('.mes[mesid="2"] .mes_edit_cancel').first().trigger('click'); await until(() => !document.querySelector('#curEditTextarea'), 'closed'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); } finally { ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_UPDATED, handler); } return { order: ctx.chat.map((m) => m.mes), updatedEvents: seen };
